review_improvement: Makes a critical whole-system power change transactional and restores the actual baseline rather than a guessed opposite mode.
independent_technical_reasoning: Power mode is global state and MaxP can increase sustained draw beyond redundant-feed or cooling headroom. A successful CLI exit is insufficient; effective telemetry must confirm the mode, and rollback must use the captured original value because the system may start in neither MaxP nor MaxQ.
